objective: Verify the Vitals module behavior for incoming sensor data in the HealthCore EHR test environment.
verifies: verifies nominal handling of the Vitals module workflow, including completion of the primary action and resulting system state update with an audit log entry
protocol: Log in as a test user with the appropriate role in the HealthCore EHR test environment.
Ensure the Vitals module is active.
Execute the primary action specified in the requirement.
Verify the system response and state change.
acceptance_criteria: An audit log entry is created.
